chapters.label: Live: Yerevan 2024
chapters.text: Yerevan, 2024. Benfica play Sporting for third place in Europe. Their pivot, Higor, scores three goals, a hat trick. Benfica win six three!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Here’s how he does it. Back to goal, he stays low and wide, his body between the ball and the defender. The defender reaches round, so he turns the other way and shoots!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. The defender can’t get to the ball. His body is the shield.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. Stay low, and use your body as a shield to protect the ball from behind!
